title: Kate Barrington, Reviewer and Editor | BettaFish.website
description: Meet Kate Barrington, the experienced pet and aquarium writer who reviews and edits BettaFish.website guides.
intro: Kate Barrington reviews and edits BettaFish.website guides for clarity, consistency and practical usefulness.

sections.heading: Relevant experience
paragraphs: Kate is a freelance writer and content strategist with more than 12 years of experience. Her published portfolio includes pet-care work and aquarium topics for outlets including Chewy and Tropical Fish Hobbyist Magazine.
A separate aquarium author profile documents more than 10 years of her writing on freshwater and saltwater aquarium topics.

sections.heading: Role at BettaFish.website
paragraphs: Kate reviews and edits assigned guides after the research and first draft are prepared. Her role covers clarity, internal consistency, practical framing and editorial quality.
Kate is not presented as an aquatic veterinarian. Her review does not convert general online information into an individualized diagnosis or replace aquatic veterinary care.
